name: Emma Darwin (née Wedgwood)

Background: plain warm mid-grey that darkens softly toward the edges, with nothing else in it. No text, no frame, no border, no signature, no watermark, no crown, jewellery or insignia unless the reference shows it.

This is a respectful historical likeness. Keep the face's proportions exactly as in the reference: do not exaggerate, idealise, glamorise, modernise or caricature any feature. Natural eyes, closed or natural mouth, no visible hands.
